# windows_environment_variable (Data Source)

Reads a single Windows environment variable (`machine` or `user` scope) from a remote host via SSH + PowerShell. Returns the stored value verbatim (unexpanded) and the registry kind (`expand`). Returns a Terraform error if the variable does not exist.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing machine-scope environment variable.
data "windows_environment_variable" "java_home" {
  name  = "JAVA_HOME"
  scope = "machine"
}

output "java_home_value" {
  value = data.windows_environment_variable.java_home.value
}

# Look up a REG_EXPAND_SZ variable — value contains raw %VAR% tokens.
data "windows_environment_variable" "tools_dir" {
  name  = "TOOLS_DIR"
  scope = "machine"
}

output "tools_dir_is_expandable" {
  value = data.windows_environment_variable.tools_dir.expand
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Windows environment variable name to look up.
- `scope` (String) Scope to look up: `"machine"` or `"user"`.

### Read-Only

- `expand` (Boolean) `true` when the registry value kind is `REG_EXPAND_SZ`; `false` when `REG_SZ`.
- `id` (String) Composite ID `"<scope>:<name>"`. Populated by the provider.
- `value` (String) Verbatim value as stored in the registry (unexpanded `%VAR%` tokens).
